message: The other day, I was trying to explain to my kids why we shouldn't leave the kitchen while frying bacon. They were more interested in making a bacon fort than listening to fire safety tips! It reminded me that sometimes the best way to teach them is to make it fun—so we turned it into a game about what to do in case of a fire. Kids need to know, but they also need to be engaged. How do you keep your little ones involved in safety discussions?
